title: What GOLMET delivers
html:
English | Português (Brasil)

What GOLMET delivers

GOLMET is the stone guardian of your product's documented truth: a CLI plus an agent toolkit that turns requirements into governed, validated, versioned knowledge — for a solo developer or for a whole company. This page lists everything it delivers, layer by layer, in one place. Each item links the deep-dive page.

1. A complete agent toolset — installed in one command

golmet install materializes the embedded toolset into your engine (OpenCode, Claude Code and more): 4 primary agents (Requirements, Documentation, Dev, DevOps), 25 subagents, 95 skills — 124 components total. Interactive wizard for a machine, explicit flags for scripts, and a final health report. See init.md.

2. Content layers — where every file comes from

Every file on your machine has a declared owner and precedence: L0 embedded (inside the binary) → L1 FULL (materialized, kit is the sole writer) → L2 packs (the organization's layer) → L3 local (your creations). Precedence: local > pack > full > base. See layers.md.

3. profile/ — your personal layer

Your client and operator identity plus the kit's canonical behavior rules (context7, stack templates). The templates live in the kit and are never installed; the config carries only the definitives (personal-by-design — never versioned, never overwritten). See profile.md.

4. Packs — the organization's knowledge, distributed

A state pack is a Git working copy cloned into your engine config — bidirectional: the team inherits it via golmet pack add/update, and you publish accumulated maturity via golmet pack publish. Inside, three shelves with canonical writers: rules/ (norms with reading triggers), domains/ (domain foundations from primary sources) and accumulation/ (patterns, metrics, nuances). Tooling inside the pack (skills/agents) is materialized into the engine; data is read in-place. See knowledge.md.

5. Reverse engineering — the documented truth of what already exists

Not every project starts from zero: the frozen source of systems in production is analyzed and turned into documented truth (models, API contracts, business rules, the UI golden master) — every claim carrying its evidence — and what is discovered enters the new workflow as candidates, not assumptions. The guided reading lets a human validate what the AI documented. See reverse.md.

6. Organization — enterprise governance

A container workspace holds multiple product workspaces, with its own golmet.yaml, a global catalog of organizations (~/.golmet/organizations.json) and two versioning models (org-repo | products-repo). The company governs norms once; every product inherits. See organization.md.

7. Deterministic self-governance

Three validators with declared contracts: golmet validate (H1-H10 — the workspace against the FORMAT), golmet doctor (S1-S5 + engine-config state: managed / personal / pack) and golmet lint (L1-L12 — dead references, orphans, stale manifest, canonical names, ghost components, canonical structure, definitive↔template conformance, registry schema, pack state, Mermaid diagrams, encoding). Runs in CI, CLI and MCP. The lint loads the whole state; the agent fixes what it points. See self-governing.md.

8. MCP server — 14 tools in the agent session

The kit serves itself via MCP: gm_validate, gm_doctor, gm_next, gm_status, gm_index, gm_eval, gm_eval_reports, gm_jev_classify, gm_lint, gm_upgrade, gm_update, gm_pack_update, gm_pack_list, gm_pack_publish. The agent session validates, routes and fixes without leaving the chat. Reference: ../reference/tools.pt-br.md (or tools.pt-br.md).

9. Self-update with verified releases

golmet upgrade fetches the latest GitHub release, verifies SHA-256 before touching the binary, swaps Windows-safe (.old rollback) and re-materializes managed content. Cross-platform binaries + npm launcher. See self-governing.md.

10. Quality gates from day one

The kit tests itself: evals (61+ fixtures scoring skills deterministically), a neutrality gate (no organization/client identity in shipped content) and golden byte-equality (source ↔ materialized). Every release runs the lint against the kit itself in CI.

11. Clean exit

golmet uninstall removes the whole structure layer by layer with real counts — everything selected by default except the packs (your local working copy is deselected; the remote repo is never touched). See init.md.

Docs in two languages

Every public doc ships in English + Português (Brasil) with an alternation badge on top — including this page.

The design in one diagram

The thesis the whole platform stands on:

The workflow is a documentary state machine of the product. The format is the contract; the kit is the deterministic engine; the runtime is the agentic layer executing by capabilities.

Three layers split by nature (each with its own change cadence and distribution channel — not by customer tier):

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 1. FORMAT — versioned spec                  │
│    workspace layout · artifact schemas ·    │
│    state transitions · evidence grammar     │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 2. KIT — deterministic CLI (no LLM)         │
│    init · validate · doctor · pack · mcp ·  │
│    upgrade · uninstall · template           │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 3. RUNTIME — agentic layer, by capabilities │
│    essential profile (any engine) · FULL    │
│    (reference runtime: OpenCode)            │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘

The normative contract lives in docs/FORMAT.md; everything this page lists is enforced by the validators of item 6.
